testcase.name: Generation reserve: non-ambient requests can never use it; ambient requests can use the whole budget
Deliverability: a variant without a supported, non-empty layer is passed over; none deliverable is SKIPPED_UNSUPPORTED
G11 strict ceiling: the next lower tier when one is missing; never a higher tier; none at or below is SKIPPED_NO_ELIGIBLE_TIER
FAILED_EVALUATION is isolated: its reservation stays counted, and later requests are planned normally
SKIPPED_INACTIVE: before the start, at or after the lifetime, every layer ended, and an empty prefix; the frame is kept
SKIPPED_NO_ELIGIBLE_TIER: decided after the viewer check and before styles and budget; never evaluated; reserves nothing
Skipped requests are never evaluated: a failing anchor with no viewers, unsupported styles or no budget is not FAILED_EVALUATION
Downgrade only: the highest tier at most the requested one that fits the generation budget
Phase 2 SKIPPED_UNSUPPORTED: admitted (a supported layer exists) but only unsupported layers are visible now
